==Senator Elections==
Each summit, a number of nations will elect [[Senator|senators]] for one or more of their territories to serve in the [[Senate]]. Each nation has a unique method of electing its senators. At the Spring Equinox 386YE, the following nations will elect Senators at the times listed in the table to the right, inside each nation's camp.

<small>
#{{anchor|1}} The next regular election for this senatorial title will take place at the Winter Solstice 386YE
#{{anchor|2}} The next regular election for this title will take place at the Summer Solstice 387YE
</small>

==Tally of the Votes==
Each summit, a number of national titles are elected via [[Tally of the Votes]]. At the Summer Solstice 386YE, elections for such titles will take place at the following times for the nations listed, in the order shown:

<tr><th>Time</th><th>Nation</th><th>Location</th><th>Titles in order of election</th></tr>

<tr><td>3:30pm</td><td>Urizen</td><td>Near Net of Heaven</td><td>[[Brilliant Star]]</td></tr>
<tr><td>4:00pm</td><td>Varushka</td><td>Central Hearth</td><td>[[Eternal Shafts of Time]]<br>[[Bargainer of the Iron Tower]]<br>[[Tolvoli Butcher]]</td></tr>
<tr><td>4:30pm</td><td>Dawn</td><td>Glory Square</td><td>[[Castellan of Spiral Castle]]<br>[[Reeve of Boar's Market]]</td></tr>
<tr><td>4:30pm</td><td>Marches</td><td>Community Hall</td><td>[[Singing Caves]]<sup>[[#3|(3)]]</sup><br>[[Alder of Meade]]<br>[[Master of the Root and Stem]]</td></tr>

==Timetable==
This timetable and much more information can be seen on the notices that get pinned up all around the Hub after time-in. <br />
For any queries regarding the IC timetabling at events you can talk to the civil service staff in the Hub.
